# Chapter 3: Mr. Chips

The dog arrived when Bob was seven years old, and he came without a name and without a history, a black-and-white bundle of fur that someone had abandoned near the subdivision where Bob lived. He was not a beautiful dog. He was the kind of dog that people called "mutt" without apology, his coloring vaguely reminiscent of a border collie but his build suggesting some other, less distinguished lineage.
